name: shimian specter
mana cost: {2}{B}{B}
types: creature specter
power toughness: 2/2
static: flying
triggered: whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player, that player reveals their hand. you choose a nonland card from it. search that player's graveyard, hand, and library for all cards with the same name as that card and exile them. then that player shuffles.
